evidence_required: a six-row answer table (layer, cause, first action, further evidence) and, for P2 and P5, the FEC margin in decades with arithmetic.

marking.criterion: P1 and P6 classified higher-layer (congestion; MTU) with correct action
P2 and P4 classified physical (bursty corruption; flap) with correct action
P3 and P5 correct (stomped frames from upstream; critical one-lane loss)
FEC margins with arithmetic: P2 0.78 decades, P5 0.43 decades

title: Interpret counters: physical or higher-layer?
